Validate synthetic data against real-world utility and diversity preservation before deployment and treat it as a conditional intervention needing governance and complementary safeguards.
Use fairness-aware methods such as adversarial debiasing and meta-learning at the outset of AI development.
Use privacy-preserving techniques such as federated learning and differential privacy for sensitive genetic data.
Align international data-sharing frameworks to enable cross-border rare disease data exchange.
Apply equity-weighted cost-utility analyses when deciding funding and deployment of AI interventions in rare disease care.
